packageRules.description: Bundle vite + vitest + @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte + @vitejs/plugin-react — they ship in lockstep and a half-updated toolchain breaks the dev server.

Bundle svelte + svelte-check + eslint-plugin-svelte + prettier-plugin-svelte + @testing-library/svelte — the Svelte 4 → 5 migration was the highest-touch bump in this project, and these packages all track Svelte's major version.
Bundle eslint + @typescript-eslint — the flat-config migration (eslint 8 → 9, typescript-eslint 7 → 8) is the last known noisy transition.
Bundle @tauri-apps/api + @tauri-apps/cli + @tauri-apps/plugin-os — the JS-side Tauri surface. The Rust-side tauri + tauri-build is grouped separately below.
Bundle tauri + tauri-build + tauri-plugin-os (Rust-side) — these move together on every Tauri minor. A split PR would not compile.
Bundle tokio + tokio-util + tokio-cron-scheduler + ssh2 + ssh-key + async-trait — the async + transport stack is one logical unit; a partial bump is a compile error.
Bundle serde + serde_json + thiserror + anyhow + tracing + tracing-subscriber — versioning is tightly coupled across the workspace.

Bundle cpal + rubato + hound + whisper-rs — the Phase 5 §5.1–5.2 audio capture + resampling + ASR stack. hound (WAV decoder) is paired with cpal (capture) and rubato (resample); whisper-rs consumes the resampled output.
vite majors are driven manually (vite 5 → 6 required a vite-plugin-svelte compat check).
vitest majors are driven manually (vitest 2 → 3 required API changes in the api-mocking layer under tests/).
svelte majors are driven manually (svelte 4 → 5 was a runes rewrite; future major transitions need the same explicit drive).
tauri majors are driven manually (tauri 1 → 2 was a full API rewrite). Until trail is on a stable major, do not propose the next major.
